query: SELECT c.name, o.order_id FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id;
gold_checklist: Must say: customer name paired with their order id, for customers who have at least one order. Must note that customers with NO orders are excluded (because of INNER JOIN).
explanation: This returns the name of each customer along with their order ID, but only for customers who have placed at least one order. Customers with no orders won't show up at all.

query: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products);
gold_checklist: Must say: products priced above the average price of all products.
explanation: Lists the names of products that cost more than the average price across all products in the catalog.

query: SELECT employee_id, salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC) AS salary_rank FROM employees;
gold_checklist: Must say: employees ranked by salary within their own department, highest salary = rank 1.
explanation: Ranks each employee's salary compared only to others in their own department, with the highest earner in each department getting rank 1.

query: SELECT name FROM employees e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.lead_id = e.id);
gold_checklist: Must say: employees who are not leading any project. Must not claim they have no projects at all.
explanation: Returns employees who are not currently the lead of any project. They might still be working on projects as a team member.
